For school visits, accessible seating must be requested on the order form and reserved in writing. TCT tries to seat caregivers or age-appropriate students together, but groups with multiple access needs may be split among nearby accessible positions; a request does not guarantee Orchestra seating for the whole group.
https://thechildrenstheatre.com/faq/
venue_official
Please indicate the number of wheelchair and/or special needs accessible seats you need on the order form. Accessible seating is limited and cannot be guaranteed unless reserved in writing.
We will always do our best to assign students and adult patrons with special needs in seating allowing for a care-giver or other students to be seated with them if they are age appropriate.
For groups including more than one patron with multiple disabilities, they may be separated into various accessible seating locations but as close together as possible.
Requiring special needs seating for select students does not guarantee orchestra floor seating for your entire school group.
